institutionRule.quote: A small number of courses in education, engineering, mathematics, law and health require you to achieve a Band 4 in HSC Mathematics Advanced or the equivalent.
institutionRule._note: The ONLY university in the MVP set with hard subject prerequisites. From the 2025 intake it dropped maths prerequisites for Commerce, Science, Medicine, Psychology, Veterinary Science and Economics.

bridging.route: Introduction to Calculus MOOC + post-MOOC examination, completed before intake

_mathsGate.quote: Mathematics Advanced (Band 4) or Mathematics Extension 1 or 2 (Band E3)
